title: Orchestration needs organized information and isolation

statements.text: Orch OR occurs when a superposition is organized, carries cognitive information and can integrate and compute, and is isolated from the random environment long enough to reach τ ≈ ħ/E_G.

Orch OR occurs when a superposition is organized, carries cognitive information and can integrate and compute, and is isolated from the random environment long enough to reach $\tau \approx \hbar / E_G$.

sources.quote: isolated from non-orchestrated, random environment long enough for the superposition EG to evolve by the U formalism to reach time τ by τ ≈ h̄/EG , then Orch OR will occur
